cases.name: testMoveDeclarationsAndAssignments
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
    DATA lv_x TYPE i VALUE 1. DATA lv_y TYPE i VALUE 2. DATA lv_z TYPE i VALUE 3.

    " comment
    lv_x += 2.lv_y -= 4.lv_z *= 6.
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
    DATA lv_x TYPE i VALUE 1.
    DATA lv_y TYPE i VALUE 2.
    DATA lv_z TYPE i VALUE 3.

    " comment
    lv_x += 2.
    lv_y -= 4.
    lv_z *= 6.
  ENDMETHOD.

cases.name: testMoveNestedIfBlocks
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
    IF lv_x > lv_y. IF lv_y < lv_z.
      lv_x = lv_z - lv_y.ELSE.lv_y = lv_z - lv_x.ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
    IF lv_x > lv_y.
      IF lv_y < lv_z.
        lv_x = lv_z - lv_y.
      ELSE.
        lv_y = lv_z - lv_x.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

cases.name: testMoveNestedDoAndIfBlocks
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
    DO 3 TIMES.lv_y *= 3.DO 5 TIMES.IF lv_x < lv_y + lv_z.lv_x += 2.lv_y -= 1.ELSE.lv_z *= 1.ENDIF.ENDDO.ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
    DO 3 TIMES.
      lv_y *= 3.
      DO 5 TIMES.
        IF lv_x < lv_y + lv_z.
          lv_x += 2.
          lv_y -= 1.
        ELSE.
          lv_z *= 1.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

cases.name: testKeepOneLinersAfterWhen
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
    CASE lv_x.
      WHEN 1. lv_x += 1. lv_y += 1.
      WHEN 2. lv_y -= 1. lv_z -= 2.
      WHEN 3. lv_z *= 2. lv_x *= 3.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
    CASE lv_x.
      WHEN 1. lv_x += 1. lv_y += 1.
      WHEN 2. lv_y -= 1. lv_z -= 2.
      WHEN 3. lv_z *= 2. lv_x *= 3.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

cases.name: testMoveOneLinersAfterWhen
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
    CASE lv_x.
      WHEN 1. lv_x += 1. lv_y += 1.
      WHEN 2. lv_y -= 1. lv_z -= 2.
      WHEN 3. lv_z *= 2. lv_x *= 3.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
    CASE lv_x.
      WHEN 1.
        lv_x += 1.
        lv_y += 1.
      WHEN 2.
        lv_y -= 1.
        lv_z -= 2.
      WHEN 3.
        lv_z *= 2.
        lv_x *= 3.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

cases.name: testKeepMultiLinersAfterWhen
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
    CASE lv_x.
      WHEN 1. lv_x += 1. do_something( iv_value = lv_x
                                       iv_name  = 'X' ).
      WHEN 2. lv_y -= 1. do_something( iv_value = lv_y
                                       iv_name  = 'Y' ).
      WHEN 3. lv_z *= 2. do_something( iv_value = lv_z ).
        do_something_else( iv_value = lv_z ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

      WHEN 3. lv_z *= 2. do_something( iv_value = lv_z ).
        do_something_else( iv_value = lv_z ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
